_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang unchanged since 0.5.0 (still master's merge commit for 0.39.0 -- pine-lang doesn't tag releases, so this is a SHA, not a tag) -- no pine-lang changes since then. beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.51.2, which bundles consistent 8px spacing around New Layout's Canvas/Results split and a fix for the desktop update notification's redundant text and invisible-looking restart button.
